notas_originais: Kel. XIII, 4 נטל חִיסּוּמָן if their steel-edge is worn off.

Y. Ber. IX, 14 a אין הארץ … לפי חִיסּוּמָה the earth drinks (absorbs the rain) only as far as its upper layer (crust) goes; Y. Taan. I, 64 b; Gen. R. s. 13, end; a. e.—Tosef. Ukts. II, 4 (T’bul Yom) ח' העליון (ed. Zuck. סל) the uppermost layer of the bone.
Cant. R. to IV, 11 אם חסרה ח' וכ' if she is suffering from the absence of one of them.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ou חִיפָּה) f. (חפף I, חוף) ḥ efa (ou ḥ ippa) uma pele que foi salgada, mas não passou pelas etapas consecutivas de curtimento com farinha e noz de bílis.
definicoes_originais: (or חִיפָּה) f. (חפף I, חוף) ḥ efa (or ḥ ippa) a skin which has been salted, but has not gone through the consecutive stages of tanning with flour and gall-nut.
notas_originais: Sabb. 79 a; Gitt. 22 a. Sifra Sh’mini, Sh’ratsim, ch. VII, Par. 6 עור האֵיפָה.
Y. Ned. II, 37 b bot.; Y. Shebu. III, 34 d top, (Bab. ib. 28 b עֵיפָא, Ms. F. איפה). Y. R. Hash. I, 56 b top.
, v. חִפּוּי

definicoes_originais: (חפף I; cmp. חִיפָּא) border-stones, pegs or stakes along the road, to prevent vehicles from trespassing on private property.
notas_originais: [Rashi: from חפף II, pegs against which vehicles rub.] Sabb. 6 a

Sifra Sh’mini, Sh’ratsim, Par. 10, ch. XII; Ḥull. 67 b.—Par. IX, 2 (doubtful; perh. scorpion, v. next w.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (ou חוּצָה) f. (חוּץ II, cmp. חָלִילָה) um ato estranho, ação não natural.
definicoes_originais: (or חוּצָה) f. (חוּץ II, cmp. חָלִילָה) a strange act, unnatural deed.
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 40 (play on חצה, Is. XXXIII, 7) חי' כתב read ḥ itsah, the angels cried חי' היא בידך מכושיני (read: מיכוס יתיה) it is unnatural on thy part to have him (Isaac) slaughtered; Gen. R. s. 56 ח' היא בִּרְיָה וכ' it is an outrage! A creature to kill his own son!; Yalk. Is. 303 חו' היא לך חו' היא לאבא למיכס ית בריה; Lam. R. to I, 2 חי' היא גביה וכ' it is unnatural for him (Abraham) &c., cmp. בָּרָיָיה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חוּץ, cmp. חַיִץ) partição, apenas em חִיצַת קנים juncos únicos plantados ao redor de um poço.
definicoes_originais: (חוּץ, cmp. חַיִץ) partition, only in חִיצַת קנים single reeds planted around a well.
notas_originais: Erub. 15 a; 19 b; Succ. 24 b מחיצת; Tosef. Erub. II, 4 (Var. מחיצת); (Y. ib. II, 20 a אישות).—Tosef. Shebi. III, 19 חישת ed. Zuck. (Var. חִיצוֹת pl.). V. חִישָׁה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָצָה) dividindo, esp. dividindo o altar em dois compartimentos por meio de uma rede (Ex. XXVII, 5).
definicoes_originais: (חָצָה) dividing off, esp. dividing the altar into two compartments by means of a net (Ex. XXVII, 5).
notas_originais: Zeb. 119 b יש ח' division is required.

Zeb. V, 1 מזבת הח' the outer altar (in the Temple court); a. fr.—Nidd. V, 1 בית הח' vagina.—Fem. חִיצוֹנָה. Y. Yeb. I, 3 a, v. חוּצָה II.—Num. R. s. 18 משנה הח' = בָּרַיְיתָא.— Pl. חִיצוֹנוֹת. Sabb. 31 b מפתחות הח' the outside keys (of the treasury); Yalk. Deut. 855; Yalk. Is. 302; En Yakob Sabb. l. c. (מפתחות) החִיצוֹנִית the keys to the outer room.

— Pl. חִיצוֹנִים. Meg. IV, 8 (24 b) דרך הח' the manner of the separatists (who follow their own interpretations of the Law, irrespective of public usages). Snh. X, 1 (90 a) ספרים הח' profane books, expl. Y. ib. 28 a top; Bab. ib. 100 b.— Fem. חִיצוֹנית, v. preced.
, v. חַצְרָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חוּר) rochas cavernosas que lembram figuras humanas. Mekh. B'shall. S. 1 (ref. a Pi-Ha ḥ iroth, Ex. XIV,; מה ח' וכ' qual era a natureza dessas rochas? - Elas não eram inclinadas, mas abruptas etc. Ib.
definicoes_originais: (חוּר) cavernous rocks resembling human figures. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 (ref. to Pi-Ha ḥ iroth, Ex. XIV,
מה ח' וכ' what was the nature of these rocks?—They were not slanting but abrupt &c. Ib.
notas_originais: הח' מצד וכ' the rocks were on one side, and Migdol &c. Ib. איו ח' אלא מקום חֵירוּתָן וכ' ḥ iroth means the place of Israel’s liberty (licentiousness); Yalk. Ex. 230; Num. R. s. 20.
, v. חֵירוּתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָרַם) exclusão, dissociação, esp. proibição de viagens entre dois países em guerra entre si.
definicoes_originais: (חָרַם) exclusion, disassociation, esp. interdiction of travel between two countries at war with each other.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 38 a בשעת ח' at a time when commercial intercourse was cut off. Ib. b יהודה … ח' דמו Judaea and Galilee are generally to be considered as if in a state of interdiction (possession in one country is no valid claim when the owner lived in the other); Y. ib. III, 14 a top.
— Pl. חֵירוּפִין, חֵר'. Ex. R. s. 41, beg. Lev. R. s. 7; a. fr.
same. Targ. Y. Num. XVI, 27.

Mekh. B’shall. s. 1, v. חִירָה. Gitt. 42 a יצא לח' becomes free (ib. 8 b, a. fr. בן חוֹרִין). Erub. 54 a (play on חָרוּת, Ex. XXXII, 16) א"ת חרות אלא חי' read not ḥ aruth (engraven) but ḥ eruth (liberty) on the tablets (you are free, if you observe the law); Ex. R. s. 32, beg. ח' מן המלכיות liberation from political oppression, ח' ממלאך המות liberation from the angel of death (pestilence); a. fr.

notas_originais: —(חֵישֶׁת) חִישַׁת קנים reed-thicket. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a top המצית את האור בח' ק' he who sets fire to a reed-thicket; [Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b bot. באִישַׁת; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 d bot. באשת, cmp. אוּשׁ a. אָשַׁשׁ].—Tosef. Shebi. III, 19, v. חִיצָה II.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָתַךְ); corte, incisão, articulação.; *(cmp. גְּזֵירָה) sentença, (condenando) veredicto.
notas_originais: Nidd. 25 a ח' ידים וכ' indications (in the embryo) of hands and feet. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 c bot.

— Pl. חִיתּוּכִין, חִתּ'. Lam. R. to II, 1 (expl. תָּו, Ezek. IX, 4) ח' ופספס sentences and verdicts (Mus. s. v. פסיפון: כתיטא בפ' like the letter Θ, for θάνατος, at voting; Yalk. Ez. 349 only פס'; Ar. s. v. פספס: חתיכה פספסן, ed. pr. התֵּיבָה).
Ḥull. 47 b ח' דאוני the incisions marking the lobes of the lung.— Pl. חִיתּוּכֵי. Ib. 48 a ח' דאוני ed. (Rashi: מקום חיתוכה דאוני) the place in the neck where the lungs begin to separate.
Ib. 48 b מחטא … בח' דריאה (Rashi: בחִיתּוּכָהּ) a needle was found in a segment of the lungs.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָתַם); assinatura.; (ברכות) ח' a fórmula com a qual uma oração termina, concluindo a bênção ('Bendito sejas tu, ó Senhor. Quem etc.').
definicoes_originais: (ברכות) ח' the formula with which a prayer closes, concluding benediction (‘Blessed be thou, O Lord. who &c.’).
notas_originais: B. Bath. X, 8 לאחר ח' שטרות after the deeds were signed. Ib. 176 a; a. fr.

Ber. 12 a הכל הולך אחר ח' ב' Ms. M. (ed. only הח') the concluding formula decides the appropriateness of a prayer. Ib. או אחר ח' ב' אזלינן Ms. M. (ed. חתימה) or do we go by the concluding phrase?— Pl. חִיתּוּמִין. Y. Ber. I, 3 d bot. אחר חִיתּוּמֵיהֶן according to their conclusions; (ib. חוֹתְמוֹתֵיהֶן, v. חוֹתָם); Y. Taan. II, 65 c bot.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָתַן) casamento; cerimônia de casamento, apenas no pl. חִיתּוּנִים, חִיתּוּנִין.
definicoes_originais: (חָתַן) marriage; wedding ceremony, only in pl. חִיתּוּנִים, חִיתּוּנִין.
notas_originais: . Num. R. s. 12 (ref. to Cant. III, 1
ח' היו וכ' the law-giving on Sinai was a wedding (between God and Israel), as we read (Ex. XIX, 10) &c., v. קִידּוּשִׁין; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 5 a; Cant. R. to l. c. כחתנים (corr. acc.).

notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIV, 9.— Pl. חִיתּוּנִין. Targ. Y. Deut. VI, 7; XI, 19 חִיתּוּנֵיכוֹן (ed. Amst. חִיתּוּנְכוֹן sing.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: sendo quebrado, subjugado; especialmente. pavor inspirado por superiores, medo.
definicoes_originais: being broken, subdued; esp. dread inspired by superiors, fear.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 34 (ref. to Gen. IX, 2, compared with I, 28) מורא וח' חזרו (not וחתות) the fear and dread (of man) were restored (after the deluge), but subjection was not. R. Hash. 17 a (applying Ez. XXXII, 24 sq.) שנתנו חִיתִּיתָם וכ' those (leaders) who tyrannize the land of the living.—Lev. R. s. 18; Koh. R. to XII, 5 (ref. to חתחתים, ib.) verbetes.glosa_atual: (n.h.), Pi.; (denominação de חַכָּה) inserir um anzol, pescar com o ângulo, fixar.; (b. h.) ficar à espreita (v. Os. VI, 9); esperar, esperar, estar ansioso (com ל).
definicoes_originais: (denom. of חַכָּה) to insert a hook, to fish with the angle, to fasten.
(b. h.) to lie in wait (v. Hos. VI, 9); to wait for, hope, be anxious for (with ל).
notas_originais: חִכָּה

Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7 c אם לחַכּוֹת בו if it is a sûgar (v. סוּגַר) with which to fasten a dog (by inserting the hook of a chain), opp. בשביל שלא לאכול one intended to prevent from eating (a muzzle); Y. Bets. II, end, 61 d (not להכות). B. Kam. 81 a ומְחַכִּין בימה וכ' and that people be free to fish with the angle in the lake of Tiberias.
Snh. 97 b (fr. Hab. II,

הַכֵּה לו wait for it (the redemption); ib. אנו מְחַכִּין והוא אינו מְחַכֶּה we are anxious, but He is not (ref. to Is. XXX, 18). Pesik. R. s. 34; Yalk. Zeph. 567; a. e. [Yalk. Lev. 604 מחכה, v. הָקָה.]
Pesik. V’zoth, p. 196 a (ref. to Is. XXX, 18) כהדין ציידא דמחכי וכ' like the hunter that waits for prey; Yalk. Deut. 950.

Targ. I Kings III, 12. Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 32; a. fr.—Ab. Zar. 76 b מאן ח' למיעבד וכ' who but R. … is wise enough to do that?; Pes. 76 a.—Tam. 32 a אידן מתקרי ח' who is to be called a wise man?; a. fr.—Esp. Ḥ akham, a scholar’s title, inferior to Rabbi. B. Mets. 86 a top ח' יתקרי וכ' shall be called a Ḥ akham, but not a Rabbi. Y. Taan. IV, 68 a דמנייתך ח' that I have appointed thee a Ḥ. (intimating that he would never be a Rabbi); a. e.— Pl. חַכִּימִין, חַכִּימַיָּא, הַכִּימֵי. Targ. Deut. I, 13. Targ. Job XL, 30 (h. text חַבָּרִים, cmp. חָבֵר); a. fr.—Nidd. 20 b כמה ח' יהודאי how wise the Jews are. Sot. IX, 15 (49 a) שרו ח' וכ' the Ḥăkhamim mim began to be (in scholarship) like common school teachers. Succ. 38 b; a. fr.— Fem. חַכִּימָא, חַכִּימְתָּא. Targ. II Sam. XX, 16; a. e.— Pl. חַכִּימָתָא. Targ. Jer. IX, 16. Targ. Jud. V, 29 חַכִּימַת (constr. pl.).

notas_originais: Y. Ber. V, 9 a bot. (in Chald. dict.), v. זְהַר. Ib. VIII, 12 b; Gen. R. s. 82, end (Ḥull. 127 a נחש). Y. Snh. R. to II, 2 עכנא כריכא).— Pl. חֲכִינִים. Cant. R. to VII, 8 [read:] חבר שהיה לו שתי ח' a charmer who had two snakes.
